Synopsis:
    Danish director May el-Toukhy's WWII-era drama "Woman Unknown" won the Golden Lion at the 2026 Venice Film Festival, with lead actress Mathilde Arcel also taking best actress. The festival drew attention to gender disparity in cinema, geopolitical themes (Gaza, Ukraine), and notable shifts in Hollywood's presence at Venice, with fewer studio-backed films. Other key awards went to Lee Chang-dong, Ilya Khrzhanovsky, and John Malkovich.
